Single patient electronic health information export.\n1. Enable a user to timely create an export file(s) with all of a single patient’s\nelectronic health information that can be stored at the time of certification by\nthe product, of which the Health IT Module is a part.\n2. The export format(s) used to support paragraphs (b)(10)(i) and (ii) of\nthis section must be kept up-to-date.\n\nPrognoCIS Workflow\nSingle Patient Data Export :\nA PrognoCIS user can perform an electronic health information (EHI) export for a Single Patient\nat any time the user chooses without developer assistance, can limit a set of users the ability to\nperform the export.\nPatient population EHI Export :\nPatient Population Data Export is handled by Bizmatics Data Migration Team as it depends on\nsize of data, time and efforts required to manage the server resources.\nThe Data Migration Team monitors the progress of the process. The process completion\nnotification is sent to Bizmatics Data Migration Team. The encrypted PHI data is stored on the\nASP/Client server.\nData Filles exported :\n• Includes EHI that can be stored at the time of certification by the product\n• Are in electronic and in a computable format\n• Includes a publicly accessible hyperlink of the export’s format\n\n\fSingle Patient Data Export\nPrognoCIS User with , CuresEHIExport’’ role can export Single Patient EHI any time the\n\nuser chooses and without subsequent developer assistance to operate.\nUser Role, CuresEHIExport is present under the Role (No Access Rights) section of the\nUser Role Master screen in PrognoCIS.\nThe CuresEHIExport User Role must be checked for a Provider, Medical Assistant, Office\nStaff or Clinical Staff user to enable the user to export data for Single Patient on Export\nPatient Data popup without password or any intervention.\nWhen a user assigned with CuresEHIExport User Role logs into PrognoCIS the Data\nExport link is available, the Single Patient radio button is selected by default for such\nuser.\nOther enabled options on the popup include:\n• Include Deleted Encounters (Use with caution)\n• Reason for Data Export\n• Check All and other listed checkboxes\n• CONFIGURE\n• CANCEL\n• EXPORT\nDisabled options on the popup include:\n• All Patients\n• Selected Patients\n• Patients of Primary Provider\n• Patients of Attending Provider\n• Encounters of Attending Provider\n• Patient Last name From-Upto\n• Data Export for Patient from SQL file\n• Encounter Date Range From and Upto\n• Data Export Password\nClicking on the Search icon invokes Patients Search List with Active Patients in\nPrognoCIS. On selecting a Patient from this popup, the name of the Patient is shown in\nthe grayed-out text field. A message is displayed beside the Search icon of this field all\nthe time. This message reads: (For All/Multiple Patients Data Export, please contact\nBizmatics Support Team)\n\n\fUser can select the checkboxes for the Type of Data to be exported and click on the\nEXPORT button. As Data Export Password field is disabled for the user with\nCuresEHIExport User Role assigned to them, validation to Enter Password is not shown\non click of the EXPORT button. Instead, a confirmation message is directly shown in a\npopup which reads: The Patient Data Export will be generated in the Background. User\nwill be notified on mail when the report is generated. Click on the OK button to close\nthe confirmation popup.\nDownload Files :\nSingle Patient Data is exported under ‘Download Files’\nNavigate to Settings → Configuration → Clinic column → Download Files\nA Category Cures EHI Export is present on the Download Files Master screen on the\nEMR side. The record for a file downloaded on exporting Single Patients is shown here.\nFiles shown under this Category are of the .zip format. The Comment column of the\nrecord shows ‘EHI Export’.
